*Where Rest Is*

Midnight -
silent bells toll soundless in my mind,
echoing the call: "Come, let us go to the house of the Lord,"
to strike my chest in the company of fellow deaf-mutes:
"vanity, vanity, vanity am I,"
but it rings hollow, empty, devoid of meaning
here in the quiet of the chapel,
where a gentle breeze from outside
makes the candles flicker, while the bells, rhythmic,
sway in silence, calling
to all who are weary.
